posts.name: PRIYADHARSAN V
posts.cooked:
@sayan @hemalatha @AtulPS @Puneet_21f3002005

Even I tried multiple solutions all my public test cases are passed but for some solutions no private cases were passed but all public cases passed. Even trying multiple solutions each time all my public test cases were passed but not the same in private cases.I want to know that what i missed because all my public cases were passing because if any one of the public test case is failed then i can figure the issue but all were passing and not able to solve all the private cases.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
The solution is simple for the first question:

while read line; do
    shell=${line##*/}
    echo "${shell^^}"
done

This passes all public and private test cases. Your might not be following the format properly, or might be not printing the \n for the last line.

posts.name: PRIYADHARSAN V
posts.cooked:
@sayan

Sir, can you please check my solution once because my roll no is 24dp2000032 , i have passed all the public cases but private test cases is passing partially or not passing for any cases .This might affect my OPPE passing marks as well even though i tried multiple solutions like once that you have mentioned.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
You have solved only \frac{4}{10} private test cases for that question.

Your solution is dependent on the path length of the shell, it always extracts the 3^{rd} field in the shell path separated by /. This is NOT a correct solution, as /bin/bash and /usr/bin/bash both are valid shells.

Screenshot 2025-08-25 at 11.46.171466×308 113 KB

Please refer above for the simpler and correct solution which always extracts the last field in the shell path.

posts.name: PRIYADHARSAN V
posts.cooked:
Sir,

Thanks for the reply .May I know why I have missed this in the public cases which might me helpful in future.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Your script might be generic enough to pass all public test cases but not generic enough to pass all private test cases. This question had a very simple solution as posted earlier, it is expected to be solved as such to make it as generic as possible and work for all shell paths.

posts.name: PRIYADHARSAN V
posts.cooked: Thank you sir for your suggestion.Hope that I will try to avoid such mistakes in future.
